name: smartprice-compare
description: Production-ready price comparison platform with React, Node, MongoDB, Redis, and pluggable store providers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.build:embed-backend: npm run build --workspace frontend && node scripts/embed-frontend.js
scripts.docker:build:backend-with-frontend: npm run build:embed-backend && docker build -t smartprice/backend -f backend/Dockerfile backend
